configuration.language.description: Language of Super Mermaid's own interface (the drawing editor toolbar, previews and messages). `auto` follows the VS Code display language. Command titles and this settings page always follow VS Code itself.

configuration.previewLocation.descriptio: Where to open the Mermaid preview. `beside` opens it as a split beside the editor (same as the built-in Markdown preview); `newWindow` pops it out into its own floating window.

configuration.previewLocation.beside: Open the preview beside the editor (split view)
